title: Deoxythymidylate Kinase (DTYMK)-Driven Pyrimidine Hypermetabolism Is Associated with a Folate-Dependent Macrophage Programme in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
snippet: Immune checkpoint blockade benefits only a minority of patients with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), and the tumour-intrinsic programmes that establish its immunosuppressive microenvironment remain poorly defined.
